verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The regularized maximum construction gives smooth psh approximants with the stated deletion and uniform-approximation properties; all test-form bidegrees, positivity, closedness, compact supports, and integration-by-parts signs are correct. Proposition 8.7.2 applies with continuous outer factor h, Corollary 18.6.2 identifies the Monge–Ampère current with the Gauss fibre including analytic multiplicities, and Proposition 18.7.3 applies with the proof-correct relative dimension n-d=1 despite the source statement's evident typo “d.” The R-PL description of h supplies the required compactly supported G-form with locally bounded tropically Borel coefficients, and the cutoff hypotheses isolate exactly the atom at z.
